subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl adopt `slacrawl-provider-v1` as a supported long-term external archive ingestion contract?
rationale: The patch is technically credible, but the new config and executable protocol create compatibility obligations that code review and green CI cannot decide.

options.title: Adopt after proof
options.body: Approve the versioned subprocess protocol after a real provider demonstrates fresh import, search visibility, and checkpoint resume.

options.title: Incubate as experimental
options.body: Keep the PR draft and explicitly mark the protocol unstable until external provider feedback validates the contract.

options.title: Decline the core contract
options.body: Keep external archive adapters source-specific or outside core rather than publishing a generic protocol.

recommendation.title: Adopt after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the versioned subprocess protocol after a real provider demonstrates fresh import, search visibility, and checkpoint resume.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent source architecture and proposed this contract, making them the strongest available direction owner.
